program.section_heading: Automotive Engine Performance Specialist - Associate of Science Degree and Certificate of Achievement - AS974/AS974C/CE974
outcomes: Diagnose, service and repair various emission controlsystems found on modern automobiles.
Diagnose, service and repair computer control systemsfound on modern automobiles.
Diagnose, service and repair common fuel injection and ignition systems found on modern automobiles.
Demonstrate personal and shop safety procedures needed to safely work in an automotive shop environment

notes: The page covers the A.S. degree and Certificate of Achievement together; the single Program Learning Outcomes list and the single requirements list are shared by both awards and recorded here for the A.S. degree.
The section heading is printed three times; the third version lists codes AS974/AS974B/AS974C/CE974 instead of AS974/AS974C/CE974.
Every course in the requirements list is marked '( Historical )' in the catalog; a reviewer should check whether these courses are still active for 2026-2027.
Outcome text copied as printed, including the run-together words 'controlsystems' and 'systemsfound'.
The degree text refers to general education 'as described in the college catalog' without naming a specific GE pattern, so ge_pattern is null.
Catalog prints codes with a hyphen (AUT-6A etc.); these match the closed-list courses AUT 6A, AUT 8A, AUT 8B, AUT 8C, AUT 50.
